newsitem.title: RUSSIA: No bids for 22 small goldfields in Russia Far East.
newsitem.headline: No bids for 22 small goldfields in Russia Far East.

text.p: Russia's Far Eastern Khabarovsk region has so far received no bids in a tender for 22 gold fields, a regional official said on Thursday.

Vasily Kochektkov of the region's geology committee told Reuters applications were invited by March 28 for the reserves, which he said contained an estimated total of 100-150 kg of gold. The sale is open to foreign and domestic investors.

A separate, recent tender for a 38 percent stake in Magadan's Orotukansky gold mining and enriching complex, also in Russia's Far East, was ruled invalid because no one had applied, Interfax news agency said on Thursday.
It quoted Yevgeny Usachyov, chairman of the Magadan regional property fund, as saying shares in the enterprise would be re-offered in May.
The plant produced 70 kg of gold last year, below its target of 1.2 tonnes.
